title: Venture-Defense OTA Bypass & Attrition Cost Inversion — Locked Telemetry Schema
description: Draft 2020-12 const-locked telemetry schema for SPEC-VENTURE-DEFENSE-OTA-BYPASS-AND-ATTRITION-COST-INVERSION-v1.0. Locks the 12 constants of the Section 5 telemetry table and the governing equations E1-E7: wrapper gross margin (E1), unit acquisition cost ratio (E2), contested-EW cost-per-successful-effect inversion (E3-E5), and TINA defective-pricing / False Claims Act treble disgorgement (E6-E7). Statutory baseline: 10 U.S.C. 4022 (OTA), 10 U.S.C. 3701-3708 (TINA), FAR Part 12 & 10 U.S.C. 3451 (commercial-item certified cost data exemption), 31 U.S.C. 3729 (FCA treble damages).

boutique_vc_drone_unit_price_usd.description: P_vc: venture-wrapper sole-source OTA unit price, USD per unit.

boutique_vc_drone_bom_cost_usd.description: C_bom: commodity bill-of-materials cost of the equivalent airframe, USD per unit.

commodity_bare_metal_fpv_unit_cost_usd.description: C_fpv: commodity bare-metal / fiber-optic FPV attrition unit cost, USD per unit.

contested_ew_boutique_survival_prob.description: p_vc: boutique platform mission completion probability under GNSS spoofing + broadband RF jamming.

fiber_optic_or_edge_fpv_survival_prob.description: p_fpv: commodity bare-metal / fiber-optic FPV mission completion probability under contested EW.

cost_per_successful_effect_boutique_usd.description: E3: CPE_vc = P_vc / p_vc = 200000.0 / 0.08 = 2500000.0 USD per successful effect.

cost_per_successful_effect_commodity_usd.description: E4: CPE_fpv = C_fpv / p_fpv = round(500.0 / 0.75, 6) = 666.666667 USD per successful effect.

thermodynamic_attrition_inefficiency_mul.description: E5: Lambda = CPE_vc / CPE_fpv = (P_vc * p_fpv) / (C_fpv * p_vc) = 300.0 / p_vc = 3750.0.

fca_treble_disgorgement_per_unit_usd.description: E7: D_FCA = 3 * D_TINA = 3 * 179300.0 = 537900.0 under 31 U.S.C. 3729 treble damages.

allowable_defense_profit_cap.description: pi_cap: allowable defense profit cap applied in E6 (baseline assumption).

governing_equations.description: Ordered equation identifiers E1 through E7 as formalized in Section 3 of the specification.

rag_indexing_vector.description: RAG indexing vector from the canonical header, verbatim.
